title: Weleda says unauthorized access to its online shop may have exposed customer and credit card records
date_note: Date of Weleda's announcement as reported by ASCII.jp; the page gives no earlier day for the announcement.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; no city given
summary: ASCII.jp reports that Weleda announced on 24 November that unauthorized access to its official online shop may have exposed customer records and credit card records, the latter including security codes. According to the report, the company has not reported confirmed fraudulent use.
plain: Weleda says its online shop was accessed without authorization and customer and card records may have been exposed. It has not confirmed fraudulent use.
exec: Weleda says card details including security codes may have been exposed; no fraudulent use has been confirmed.

validation.note: Only ASCII.jp read, relaying Weleda's announcement; Weleda's own notice not found.
